verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Entra ID accepting natural-language commands to operate it, such as a copilot or NL admin assistant. Graph Explorer, the Graph API and its metadata are developer and API tooling, not natural-language operation. The MCP probe points to a Microsoft Learn training-support page, not an Entra natural-language interface, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
